verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official REST Developer API with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec and Swagger UI served by each instance. It does not mention any official SDK or client library in any language. A raw HTTP API and spec are building blocks a developer could use to generate or write a client; they are not a vendor-shipped SDK. The Custom Agent Skill guide covers in-app plugin development, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
